claims.text: 30 Jul 2026 Board of Peace disarmament agreement: weapons inventoried within 14 days of acceptance, held only by a Palestinian National Committee, none transferred to Israel; heavy weapons, production sites, depots and tunnels first; Israeli withdrawal stage by stage with verification; ~5,000 ISF troops pledged; Hamas's Ghazi Hamad: no step if Israel doesn't withdraw; Israel had not publicly accepted.
Unnamed Israeli diplomatic source: full disarmament and demilitarization before any withdrawal; 'There will be no Israeli withdrawal from the Yellow Line.'
Sep 2026: IDF sources said Hamas was reclaiming weapons from depots; IDF struck depots; Netanyahu said Israel controls 60% of the Strip and disarmament efforts will continue.

Board of Peace formed Jan 2026; UNSC Res 2803 (17 Nov 2025) mandated a stabilization force; Hamas rejected a March 2026 disarmament plan in April; National Committee for the Administration of Gaza formed 14 Jan 2026; Hamas announced resignation of its civil administration 6 Jul 2026; last hostage body recovered 26 Jan 2026.
